description: Find the Mango Inventory help pages that answer a question. Works without an account. Takes the question in a few words (in any of the help languages or in English) and the language for the links. Returns up to five help pages with the section that matched.

language.description: Language of the help-page links: en (default), de, fr, it or es.

question.description: The question in a few words, e.g. "vans with their equipment" or "safety inspections". Up to 300 characters.

name: find_docs

section.description: The heading on that page that matched

title: Find a help page
